text.content:
The most ancient Kindred of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} build power bases terrifying in scope, becoming the essence of the very cities they dwell in. These Influence ratings of 6 through 10 sit far beyond the reach of the core game's normal 1-5 scale, and obtaining them requires decades, if not centuries, of patient work — such power belongs only to the most ancient and established elders. Neonates should not even dream of holding this kind of empire. Influence tends to run deep rather than broad even at these heights: very few Kindred, however powerful, ever control an entire nation.

Bureaucracy

A Kindred with this much Influence has spent decades shaping the machinery of city government itself. At Trait 7, she can initiate major public works or dominate a city block's bureaucracy outright, or halt emergency services during a major disaster. At Trait 8, she can alter state or regional policy, force a neighborhood to rebuild as she wishes, or build and destroy small towns. At Trait 9, she controls an entire city district and can rewrite regional policy or condemn major buildings on short notice. At Trait 10, she commands the mayor's office completely and can rebuild the city to her own design.

Finance

Elders who came of age as merchant princes now find themselves outpaced by the speed of modern markets, and many delegate this Influence to ambitious ancillae. At Trait 6, a Kindred can wipe out an individual's savings, manipulate a minor commodity's price, or profit from insider trading. At Trait 7, she can sway local stock prices or buy a minor nationwide corporation. At Trait 8, she can control a major commodity's price or trigger regional inflation or depression. At Trait 9, she can siphon the profits from a minor corporation or own a major nationwide one. At Trait 10, she can crash the stock market, bend nationwide economic trends, or make someone an instant millionaire.

High Society

This Influence tends to sit in the hands of younger Kindred, since true fame and the Masquerade rarely mix; those who hold it become the makers of celebrities rather than celebrities themselves. At Trait 6, a Kindred can own a small but influential gallery or theater, or grant someone a fleeting taste of fame. At Trait 7, she can bring a major touring production to the city or end a minor celebrity's career. At Trait 8, she can seat anyone among the city's elite or create a genuine minor celebrity. At Trait 9, she can make herself or another a major celebrity, or own a large gallery or theater. At Trait 10, she can create major celebrities outright, shape nationwide fashion, destroy a major celebrity's career, or control the city's premier venue.

Industry

Many elders, more comfortable with steel and stone than silicon, cede this Influence to eager young ancillae. At Trait 6, a Kindred can attract major heavy industry to the area or illegally dump toxic waste without consequence. At Trait 7, she can siphon company profits, start or break a union, or engineer a major ecological disaster. At Trait 8 and beyond, she can fatally sabotage a major construction project or own a major heavy industry or construction firm outright. At Trait 9-10, she can trigger a major strike, sabotage an entire industrial product line, or sway nationwide labor movements.

Political

Political Influence offers dizzying heights of power, though many Kindred prefer to work through appointed proxies rather than stand in the spotlight themselves. At Trait 6, a Kindred can enact major local legislation or install a candidate in a major city office such as mayor. At Trait 7, she can end a major local politician's career. At Trait 8, she can install a candidate in federal office, such as the Senate, or pass minor national legislation. At Trait 9, she can embezzle vast public funds or engineer a major political scandal. At Trait 10, she can throw her weight behind a national candidate or propose major national legislation.

Transportation

This Influence lets an elder strangle a city or let it thrive, controlling who enters and who leaves. At Trait 6, a Kindred can bar an individual from public transportation or attract a major transportation hub, such as an airport, to her city. At Trait 7, she can halt all transport and shipping to a small town or siphon profits from a shipping firm. At Trait 8, she can bar specific cargo from a city or isolate a small town from all transportation, including highways. At Trait 9, she can cause a major transportation disaster or destroy a major transportation hub. At Trait 10, she can dominate an entire mode of regional transport (air, rail, or shipping), seal a city off entirely, or bar all cargo from a major city.

University

Many elders, former tutors and monks in life, recreate their old roles within the halls of academia, and a campus under a powerful Kindred's Influence gradually becomes an extension of her own personality. At Trait 6, a Kindred can falsify a graduate degree or discredit the head of a department. At Trait 7, she can falsify a doctorate or produce a well-connected contact with rare Abilities or esoteric knowledge. At Trait 8, she can discredit or appoint a college dean, or divert university funds to her own purposes. At Trait 9, she can direct an entire department's research toward a chosen problem or secure a permanent research assistant as an Ally. At Trait 10, she can create a college class of her choosing or destroy or utterly discredit an entire college.

Underworld

The Camarilla has held a foothold in organized crime since the Mafia's inception, though rival clans and the arrival of Eastern vampires keep that grip contested. At Trait 6, a Kindred can locate exotic weaponry such as bombs or sniper rifles, or contract a professional hit. At Trait 7, she can launder large sums of money or supply the drug trade of an entire city. At Trait 8, she can control the head of a small crime family or acquire unique, custom weaponry. At Trait 9, she can put a price on anyone's head or ignite a war between crime families. At Trait 10, she can control the head of a major crime family or stage a public assassination, terrorist act, or shooting spree and walk away clean.

These summaries are deliberately broad; a Storyteller wielding master-level Influence on behalf of an elder NPC (or approving it for a player character of sufficient age and standing) should tailor the specific application to the story at hand.
